fields.spec_version: ETG Brochure — EtherCAT and ETG Introduction (March 6, 2024) referencing IEC 61158 Type 12 + IEC 61784 CPF 12 + ISO 15745-4 + SEMI E54.20 base spec
previous_versions: EtherCAT introduced by Beckhoff Automation at the Hannover Fair, April 2003 (first public demonstration of on-the-fly Ethernet fieldbus)
EtherCAT Technology Group founded November 2003 to standardize EtherCAT as an open technology
IEC 61158-3-12 + IEC 61158-4-12 + IEC 61158-5-12 + IEC 61158-6-12 published 2007 — EtherCAT becomes formal IEC standard (Type 12 of the IEC 61158 family)
IEC 61784-1 CPF 12 + IEC 61784-2 CPF 12 — Communication Profile Family 12 = EtherCAT
Safety over EtherCAT (FSoE) standardized as IEC 61784-3-12 (2010) — black-channel safety, SIL 3 / Cat 4 / PL e
ETG.1500 Conformance Test specification — mandatory for ETG-certified SubDevices
ETG.2000 EtherCAT Slave Information XML schema — machine-readable ESI
ETG.5003 Modular Device Profile (MDP) — uniform multi-module device representation in CoE Object Dictionary
ETG.1020 EtherCAT Protocol Enhancements — extensions absorbed back into base spec over time

key_changes.summary: 100 Mb/s Industrial Ethernet fieldbus with on-the-fly frame processing; 13 addressing commands; ESM 4 states; FMMU + SyncManager memory model; Distributed Clocks.
Layered safety frame on mailbox; SIL 3 capable.
Single-cable variant combining 100BASE-TX data with 2 × 24 V DC power rails (US + UP).
Upgrade to 1 Gb/s and 10 Gb/s wire rates; protocol layers above the PHY unchanged.
Updated technical + marketing overview of EtherCAT and the ETG.

future_versions_industry_outline.summary: Further deployment of gigabit + 10G variants across the installed base.
Coexistence with IEEE 802.1 TSN domains via cross-traffic gateways and harmonized time synchronization.
Plant-floor integration with OPC-UA model exchange (EAP + CSP+).
EtherCAT MainDevices as edge gateways for cloud telemetry while preserving deterministic field-side performance.

fields.trademark_and_licensing: EtherCAT® is a registered trademark and a patented technology licensed by Beckhoff Automation GmbH, Germany. Free, royalty-free use is permitted for ETG members in compliance with the ETG license terms.
standardization_bodies: EtherCAT Technology Group (ETG) — open membership organization administering the technology
International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) — IEC 61158 / IEC 61784 / IEC 61918
AIDA — Automotive Industry-Driven Assembly initiative (automotive line standardization)
